description: Details pursuant to conditions 30 (car park design and management plan) and 32 (building management plan incorporating delivery and servicing plan) of Full Planning Permission reference 20/3914 dated 29 October, 2021, for Demolition of the existing buildings and structures, the erection of a building ranging in height up to 28 storeys, incorporating residential units and industrial, community and commercial uses, together with associated landscaping, access arrangements, car and cycle parking, servicing and refuse and recycling subject to Deed of Agreement dated 28 October 2021 under Section 106 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
